name: ToolsPad
description: Manage CRM contacts, notes, tasks, lead forms and appointments in one team workspace through a hosted MCP connection with revocable, workspace-scoped OAuth access.

skills.name: Create CRM Contacts
skills.description: Create a CRM contact in the authorized workspace and keep its client context alongside related notes and tasks.

skills.name: Organize Team Tasks
skills.description: Create or update a task in the authorized workspace with its list, responsible person and due date.

skills.name: Capture Workspace Notes
skills.description: Create and update notes in the connected workspace so an approved workflow can retain its business context.

skills.name: Create Lead Forms
skills.description: Create a lead form with required name and email fields using the documented workspace-authorized MCP workflow.

skills.name: Schedule Appointments
skills.description: Create or update appointment and calendar records through the approved workspace connection and access mode.

authInstructions: Connect https://app.toolspad.com/mcp in a compatible MCP client. Sign in to ToolsPad, select one workspace, and approve read-only or read-and-write access. Revoke access from Settings → AI connections.
